gspot 0.1.0 · [Source definition](https://github.com/stefanionescu/gspot/blob/main/presets/concern/static-site/manifest.toml)

A site built to a folder and served as files: the build, its output, its links, its weight, its sitemap, and its headers.

Kind: concern. Requires: `html`, `css`, `javascript`.

## Tools

- linkinator 6.1.4
- svgo 4.1.0
- purgecss 7.0.2

## Checks

| Check                                                                                  | Stage  | What it finds                                                                                             |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`static-site/build`](/reference/rules/static-site/build/)                             | push   | Runs the build command of the site and fails when it fails or writes no output folder.                    |
| [`static-site/build-reproducible`](/reference/rules/static-site/build-reproducible/)   | push   | Builds the site twice and compares the two outputs file by file.                                          |
| [`static-site/html-validate-built`](/reference/rules/static-site/html-validate-built/) | push   | Validates every built page with html-validate.                                                            |
| [`css/dead-selectors`](/reference/rules/css/dead-selectors/)                           | push   | Finds selectors of the built stylesheets that no built page or script uses.                               |
| [`static-site/links-internal`](/reference/rules/static-site/links-internal/)           | push   | Serves the built site and follows every link between its pages, stylesheets, and fragments.               |
| [`static-site/links-external`](/reference/rules/static-site/links-external/)           | manual | Follows every link of the built site, the ones that leave it included.                                    |
| [`static-site/size`](/reference/rules/static-site/size/)                               | push   | Sums the compressed weight of the output paths each ceiling in tools.site.size_limits names.              |
| [`static-site/sitemap`](/reference/rules/static-site/sitemap/)                         | push   | Compares the sitemap with the output: every listed route is a built page, and every built page is listed. |
| [`static-site/dead-assets`](/reference/rules/static-site/dead-assets/)                 | push   | Finds files under an assets folder that no page, stylesheet, or script names.                             |
| [`static-site/svg`](/reference/rules/static-site/svg/)                                 | commit | Checks that svgo cannot make any SVG smaller.                                                             |
| [`static-site/webmanifest`](/reference/rules/static-site/webmanifest/)                 | commit | Checks that the web manifest parses, names the app, and lists icons that exist.                           |
| [`integrity/security-headers`](/reference/rules/integrity/security-headers/)           | commit | Checks that the headers file sets the content type, referrer, and framing headers for every path.         |

## Settings

- `tools.site.build`: The command that builds the site.
- `tools.site.output`: The folder the build writes.
- `tools.site.size_limits`: Weight ceilings: the output paths, and the most kilobytes they may weigh compressed.
- `tools.site.sitemap_excluded`: Built pages the sitemap leaves out on purpose.
- `tools.purgecss.safelist`: Class names a script adds at run time: the names and the reason.
- `tools.linkinator.skip`: Links the crawl skips: a pattern and the reason.
